title: Irudhi Suttru
desc: A failed boxer sees potential in a roadside fish-seller and begins to train her to compete in the women's boxing category in the Olympics.

title: En Bommukutti Ammavukku
desc: Vinod and Lakshmi, who lost their daughter in an accident, adopt Tinu, a vivacious young girl, from an orphanage. However, the family faces challenges when Tinu's birth parents set out to find her.

title: Mannuketha Ponnu
desc: A man is very loyal towards his master who has also raised him. When his master's daughter returns to the village, the two fall in love after initial hiccups.

title: Dhaya
desc: Rudrayya, a retired soldier, wants to settle scores with Sharada Amma, a woman who runs an orphanage. He hires Dhaya who disguises himself as Sharada Amma's driver while planning her downfall.

title: Veeram Velancha Mannu
desc: Durai Pandi, a lumberjack, is very fond of his sister Meenamma and aims to make her the district collector. However, the MLA tricks him into cutting sandalwood trees and smuggling illegal goods.
